content: शक् I. €5 <ab>P.</ab> (शक्नोति, शक्त) .²1 To be able, be competent for, have power to effect (usually with an <ab>inf.</ab> and translatable by ‘can’); अदर्शयन् वक्तुमशक्नुवत्यः शाखभिरावर्जितपल्लवाभिः <ls>R. 13. 24</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 6</ls>; <ls>Me. 20</ls>; sometimes, with <ab>acc.</ab> or <ab>dat.</ab>; दानेन वधनिर्णेकं सर्पादीनामशक्नुवन् <ls>Ms. 11. 139</ls>; with <ab>gen.</ab> also; see शक्त. .²2 To bear, endure. .²3 To be powerful. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} To be able, be possible or practicable (giving a passive sense to a following infinitive); तत् कर्तुं शक्यते ‘it can be done’. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (शिक्षति) .²1 To wish to be able. .²2 To learn. --II. €4 <ab>U.</ab> (शक्यति-ते, शक्त) .²1 To be able, have power to effect. .²2 To bear, endure. .²3 To give. .²4 To aid. .²5 To know (mostly <ab>Ved.</ab> in these senses).
